_comment: Case matrix for block-busy-loop.sh, read by block-busy-loop.test.sh. The hook is global, so there is no in_scope field. Verdicts here are the hook's ACTUAL behaviour, verified by running it: it blocks a no-op spin body (`do :;` / `do true;`) and a non-blocking liveness poll, and it is deliberately conservative everywhere else — a `sleep` or `wait` token anywhere in the command allows it, and a loop with a real body it cannot classify is allowed.

cases.command: while pgrep foo; do true; done
while kill -0 12345; do echo still running; done
while read -r line; do echo $line; done < file
cat f | while read line; do echo $line; done
